articles.title: Franklin Templeton teams up with MoonPay to let big investors swap stablecoins for yields 24/7
articles.snippet: The Wall Street giant is integrating its tech platform with MoonPay's infrastructure, allowing eligible institutions to seamlessly swap stablecoins for yield-generating tokenized funds without ever leaving the blockchain.

articles.title: Movement pivots to stablecoin payments as the layer-2 boom loses momentum
articles.snippet: The team behind Movement said it plans to leverage licensed payment partners alongside blockchain settlement rails to target the roughly $685 billion remittance market serving low and middle-income countries.

articles.title: Ripple’s dollar stablecoin expands to Turkey through three local platforms
articles.snippet: BiLira, Bitexen and Bitlo will make Ripple’s RLUSD stablecoin available to Turkish institutions.

articles.title: MoneyGram launches stablecoin on Stellar, joining rush toward digital dollar payments
articles.snippet: MGUSD, issued by Stripe's Bridge, will power services across MoneyGram's global network as stablecoins gain traction in cross-border payments.

articles.title: Movement expands stablecoin payments push with access to US, Canada, EU rails
articles.snippet: The Move-based blockchain network said it gained access to licensed payment infrastructure as it shifts toward stablecoin settlement and remittances.
